facts.en: Completed an administration diploma at Fictional Elm College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构榆树学院完成行政管理文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid scheduling assistant at Fictional Lantern Rooms from 2021-01 to 2024-12.
facts.zh: 2021-01 至 2024-12 在虚构灯笼活动室任有薪排期助理。

facts.en: Paid programme coordinator at the same employer from 2025-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2025-01 至 2026-08 在同一雇主任有薪项目协调员。

facts.en: Volunteer session organizer at Fictional Paper Circle from 2022-01 to 2023-12, averaging 3 weekend hours weekly during the paid role.
facts.zh: 2022-01 至 2023-12 在虚构纸艺社任志愿活动组织员，与有薪岗位同期，平均每周周末工作 3 小时。

facts.en: The volunteer dates overlap paid employment and must not be added as extra elapsed career years.
facts.zh: 志愿活动日期与有薪工作重叠，不得累加为额外的职业经历年数。

facts.en: Maintained room calendars and checked facilitator availability for paid programmes.
facts.zh: 为有薪项目维护活动室日历并检查主持人可用时间。

facts.en: Escalated room conflicts to the programme manager; did not approve staffing budgets.
facts.zh: 向项目经理上报活动室冲突；不审批人员预算。

facts.en: Co-created a calendar handover checklist with a colleague in 2025-02.
facts.zh: 2025-02 与一名同事共同制作日历交接核对表。

facts.en: Personally wrote the pending-change fields; the colleague defined facilitator-contact fields.
facts.zh: 个人编写待处理变更字段；主持人联系字段由同事定义。

facts.en: In a 2025-03 review, 27 of 30 sampled handovers included all required fields; no comparable baseline was recorded.
facts.zh: 2025-03 审核中，30 份抽样交接记录有 27 份包含全部必填字段；未记录可比基线。

facts.en: Uses shared calendars, spreadsheet filters and written handover notes.
facts.zh: 使用共享日历、电子表格筛选及书面交接备注。

facts.en: Drafted an automated reminder proposal in 2026-01; it was not implemented.
facts.zh: 2026-01 起草自动提醒提案；未实施。

facts.en: At the volunteer group, arranged craft materials rather than managing paid programme bookings.
facts.zh: 在志愿团体中安排手工材料，并非管理有薪项目预订。

facts.en: Prepared 6 volunteer craft-session material lists in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年准备 6 份志愿手工活动材料清单。

facts.en: Completed a 2024 internal calendar-tool orientation with no external qualification.
facts.zh: 2024 年完成内部日历工具入门培训，无外部资格。

facts.en: Built a fictional museum timetable as coursework in 2020; it was not a client project.
facts.zh: 2020 年课程中制作虚构博物馆时间表；不是客户项目。

facts.en: Prepared cancellation notices from approved templates.
facts.zh: 依据获批模板准备取消通知。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing imaginary railway maps.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制想象中的铁路地图。

facts.en: An old biography adds volunteer and paid durations together; the dated records show concurrent work.
facts.zh: 旧简介将志愿活动与有薪工作时长相加；日期记录显示工作同期进行。

facts.en: No programme-budget ownership or procurement approval is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录项目预算负责或采购审批权限。
